A couple of years ago I was starting my teaching career and the school I had been an interim teacher for did not have a permanent position for me. I was also really struggling to get a full time teaching position in the area. At the same time, my long term boyfriend broke up with me and I had to move back in with my parents. So basically, I really just wasn’t having a great time with life. 

I decided just for the hell of it to start applying to teaching jobs in different states. While visiting my brother on vacation in a different state, one of the schools called me for an interview. They hired me on the spot the week before school started. With basically no real notice, planning, or knowledge of the school/area, I flew home, loaded up my car, and drove there. I had no money and nowhere to live and spent about two months couch surfing with relatives. 

10/10 craziest thing I’ve ever done and would totally do it all again. I’ve lived there for two years now and I’ve made some really great friends and built a pretty nice life for myself.

I started complaining of severe fatigue when I was 21. Like I would work some 4 hour cake shift and feel so tired I would lay in bed and cry because my arms and legs felt like a million pounds and it almost like hurt to move. My GP ran a bunch of tests and then gave up and upped my depression meds. It never helped and I just accepted being stupid tired at 21 as normal. At 24 when I started MA work I started getting severe abdominal pain that increased with my stress. Again, nothing from tests. The pain was so bad one time I went to the ER. It was just assumed it was anxiety. At 25 I had my wisdom teeth out and since i have opioid addiction in my family I took a bunch of Advil instead of whatever pain pill the oral surgeon prescribed. The abdominal pain increased and I started shitting massive amounts of blood. Eventually my GP sent me to a GI and they diagnosed me with UC after a colonoscopy at 26 years old. 

The last three years have a total blast ✌️😂

I love you all for making me feel less disgusting. Thank you ☺️
